summary: A row of slides of which one shows at a time, with buttons to go to the next and the previous.

root.note: Stacks the slides and the controls.

slides.note: The element marked data-part="slides" whose child elements are the slides. It scrolls sideways and snaps to a slide.

previous.note: A button the author marks with data-part="previous".

next.note: A button the author marks with data-part="next".

events.change: Dispatched after the user goes to another slide.

guidance.text: The author names the carousel with aria-label. Each slide is named by its position, such as 2 of 5, unless the author names it.

notYet: A set of dots to pick a slide.
